question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Guidance for Q1 FY27 is $89.85-90.95B (mid $90.4B), consensus ~$90.6-90.7B. Microsoft has beaten its guidance midpoint by ~1.5-3% in recent quarters (Q4 FY26: $90.0B vs ~$87.6B consensus, +2.7%). Applying a ~2% beat gives ~$92.2B. Upside: Azure guided at 44-45% cc, and TD Cowen expects an above-normal beat from OpenAI capacity. Downside: Windows OEM down in the low 20s %, gaming declining, and the dollar strengthened late in the quarter after the Fed hike. No human prediction market was found (Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold). Median ~$92.1B.
calls.dossier:
- Q1 FY27 guidance (Jul 29 2026 call, investing.com transcript): total revenue $89.85-90.95B (+16-17% YoY); FX expected to reduce growth by <1pt. Old segments: Productivity & Business Processes $36.7-37.0B; Intelligent Cloud $40.95-41.25B (Azure ~45% cc); More Personal Computing $12.2-12.7B (Windows OEM/devices down low 20s %, search ads up mid-single digits, Xbox content down mid-single digits). New segments: Agents & Infra $75.15-75.75B; Devices & Consumer $14.7-15.2B.
- Q1 FY26 (year-ago) revenue: $77.673B. Q4 FY26 revenue: $90.007B (+18%) vs consensus ~$87.61B (+2.7% beat).
- Consensus Q1 FY27 revenue as of Oct 2026: ~$90.61-90.71B (MarketBeat, Seeking Alpha/TradingView); one outlier at $92.45B.
- Historical pattern: MSFT reported revenue beat the guidance midpoint by roughly 1.5-3% in each FY26 quarter (Q1 FY26 ~+2.1%, Q2 ~+1.5%, Q3 ~+2%, Q4 ~+3%; approximate, guidance ranges for prior quarters not all verified).
- TD Cowen (Oct 2026): expects the beat to top last quarter's ~3%; Azure est. 45% cc; OpenAI incremental quarterly revenue ~$1B in 1H CY26 rising to ~$4-5B in 2H CY26; big-4 cloud bookings +125% YoY in CQ3.
- FX: DXY rose ~2.4% from Sep 9 after the Fed's Sep 16 hike to 3.75-4%; DXY ~101.45 in Sept and ~102 in Oct (usmacro) — a mild headwind vs July assumptions.
- Downside factors: weak PC market, component (memory) prices, Windows 10 end-of-support comp, Xbox decline.
- Status quo: revenue lands at or above the guidance range; a miss below the low end ($89.85B) has not happened in recent years.
- Resolves off the total revenue in Microsoft's Q1 FY27 earnings release (expected Oct 28 2026, 8-K), initial figure.
- Event window: quarter Jul 1 -> Sep 30 2026 already complete; release Oct 28 2026; as of Oct 19, 100% of the quarter has elapsed and only the report is pending.
- Searched for but not found: a Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold market on MSFT revenue; an explicit FX update since July.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the guidance ($89.85-90.95B), the Q4 FY26 actual ($90.007B, +3.2% vs mid) and the absence of a human market. Disputes: (1) beat-history magnitude. Run 2 cites FY25 beats up to 3.7%, unverified; I used the FY26 series (1.5-3.2%, mean ~2.2%), consistent with all dossiers. (2) Consensus $90.7B vs ChartMill $92.46B. Not settleable without web access; most sources say ~$90.7B and ChartMill is likely stale or misaggregated; immaterial because I anchor on guide plus beat. (3) FX headwind size is judgment; Run 2's ~-0.3% is plausible given the ~2% DXY rise late in the quarter. I carry forward the runs' ~$2.2-2.4B dispersion, which is consistent with the beat-SD computation plus a margin. No new retrieval this run.
